title: Git deploy
notSetUp: This site does not deploy from Git. An administrator or a manager of the site can set up a repository.

deploys.title: Deploys
deploys.intro: A deploy fetches the newest commit of <code1>{{branch}}</code1> into a new release, runs the build commands as the user {{user}} and only then switches <code2>{{dir}}</code2> to it. A failed build never goes live.
deploys.needsHostKey: Confirm the server's host key below before the first deploy.
deploys.disabled: The site is disabled: enable it to deploy.
deploys.truncated: The log is long; this is its end.

repo.title: Repository
repo.noCommands: None: the files are deployed as they are in the repository.
repo.removeText: Remove the repository, its key and webhook? The live files stay.

form.label: Git repository
form.intro: Hostashi fetches a branch of a repository into a new release below .deploy/releases, runs your build commands as the user {{user}} and then switches the deploy directory to it in one step. The files now in the deploy directory are kept as the first release.
form.urlHint: https://github.com/acme/site.git, or git@github.com:acme/site.git for a private repository with a deploy key.
form.authSsh: Private, with a deploy key (SSH): Hostashi makes the key, you add it to the repository as read only
form.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored token.
form.tokenHint: A token that can only read this repository. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.tokenUserHint: Only if the Git host needs one, such as oauth2 for GitLab.
form.deployDirHint: The folder below the home that serves the live release, usually htdocs.
form.commandsHint: One command per line, run in the new release as the site user, in this order. A command that fails stops the deploy.
form.replacedBoth: {{preset}} replaced your own build commands and shared paths.
form.sharedHint: One per line, relative to the release, such as .env or wp-content/uploads. They stay across deploys; files the site writes elsewhere are replaced by the next deploy.

keys.title: Deploy key and host key
keys.deployKeyHint: Add it to the repository as a read-only deploy key (GitHub, Gitea and Forgejo: Settings, Deploy keys; GitLab: Settings, Repository, Deploy keys).
keys.copyFailed: Copying is not possible here. Select the key and copy it by hand.
keys.replaceText: The current key stops working at once. Add the new key to the repository before the next deploy.
keys.confirmed: Confirmed: {{fingerprint}}. Deploys connect only to a server with this key.
keys.notConfirmed: Not confirmed yet. Read the key the server presents and compare its fingerprint with the one the Git host publishes.
keys.comparePublished: Compare it with the fingerprints {{host}} publishes. Trust it only if it matches exactly.
keys.compareOwn: Compare it with the fingerprint your Git server's administrator gives you. Trust it only if it matches exactly.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.intro: With the webhook on, a push to <code1>{{branch}}</code1> deploys the site. GitHub, Gitea, Forgejo and GitLab sign their calls with the secret; a script can send it as <code2>Authorization: Bearer</code2>.
webhook.enterNow: Enter these in the Git host now
webhook.once: The secret is shown only once. Content type: application/json; event: push.
webhook.copyFailed: Copying is not possible here. Select the text and copy it by hand.

check.url: Enter the address of the repository.
check.local: Use an https:// or SSH address; local paths and git:// are not supported.
check.sshNeeded: A deploy key needs an SSH address, like git@github.com:acme/site.git.
check.httpsNeeded: Without a deploy key the address must start with https://.
check.deployDir: The deploy directory is a folder below the home, like htdocs.
check.sharedRelative: Shared paths are relative to the release, like .env.
check.timeout: The build time limit is 1 to {{max}} minutes.

errors.git_unavailable: Git deploy is not available on this panel.
errors.deploy_unavailable: Git deploys are not available on this panel: the agent does not answer.
errors.deploy_running: A deploy of this site is running. Wait until it ends.
errors.host_key_unconfirmed: Confirm the server's host key first.
errors.not_ssh: The site does not deploy over SSH.
errors.ipv4_only: The repository's server has only IPv4 addresses and this server has no IPv4 route. An IPv6-only server needs NAT64 to reach it, see the Git deploy page in the wiki.
errors.unreachable: The repository's server did not answer over SSH. Check the address and port.
errors.invalid_host_key: This is not a host key Hostashi can pin: Ed25519, ECDSA or RSA with at least 3072 bits.
errors.not_deployable: Only a successful deploy can be rolled back to.
errors.deploy_not_found: This deploy is no longer in the history.
